notes:
Improved
• Forgetting the line is cut: "wait, what do I say again", "what was I saying", "where was I", "I forgot my line", "let me try that again", "take two", "I messed up". When it's in the middle of a longer
• Off-camera talk is cut. A line said well under your normal voice to someone in the room ("can you pass me the charger", "walk your character into the camera") goes. So does anything so quiet it was cl
• Quiet lines said to the viewer stay ("let's go guys!"), and so do lines said to someone in the game.
• Recording talk is cut: "can you hear me", "is this on", "hit record", "am I supposed to be recording".
• Words like "start over" or "one more time" are only cut when they are the whole line, so a story about starting over from the beginning stays.
• A fail gets a big red X slammed on screen with a quick red flash, landing with the wrong-answer buzzer.
• A zoom that punches onto something on screen (the text or thing you point at) whooshes in. That's at most one every 15 seconds, and never on a subtle face push.
• "Cut this clip" cuts the clip under your playhead.
• No risers into nothing, and no random vine booms.
• Music changes in the pause, with a crossfade.
